note: First-pass numbers chosen by the assistant on 2026-11-14. None has been tuned with players. Version 3: the second decision is a call to Trauma Team (ids still say 'refer'); a call on a steady patient now costs the call-out (false_call). Agent limits were raised for typed and spoken conversation: 16 patient-model calls per visit, a 4 s wait, replies asked to stay within 110 characters and shown up to 220 (two pages of the strip); the proxy must hold the same numbers. Push-to-talk (agent.voice): a clip is at most 10 s, 24 clips per visit, 7 s to wait for its words; quieter than silence_peak is not sent. Version 4 (2026-11-15, after the student's eleven notes): the flat rent became an hourly line (line.per_hour: one visit is one hour, the meter is read after each, and the last reading decides the night); a patient whose patience reaches 0 waits patience.leave_ms and then leaves unpaid and unbilled (outcome gave_up); the counter glass takes attack.glass blows per shift, attack.blow_at places them inside window_ms, and with less glass left the patient comes through sooner, never sooner than attack.min_window_ms. Version 5 (2026-11-16, after the student's notes on the screen and the glass): between patients the doctor can pay attack.repair_cost credits for one layer of the counter glass. It takes one more blow, and an empty frame has a pane again. The money leaves the till at once and the meter counts it at every later reading. No other number changed.

arrivals.note: Added 2026-11-15: shift_order is who comes in; each shift draws the order from its seed. The first shift of a session opens with a steady patient. --authored-order keeps the listed order (tests and captures).

line.note: What the lender's meter wants in the till at each hourly reading: hour n needs n x per_hour. Five hours make 600, the old rent. 120 is also the hand-over fee, so a right call on a drifting patient exactly holds the line for that hour.

patience.note: At 0 the patient gives an ultimatum and leaves after this long unless the player decides or reassures. 0 makes them leave at once.

attack.note: blow_at: when each blow lands on the glass, as a share of window_ms. A blow that lands before the shutter is down costs one of the glass points. With g points left only g blows land and the patient comes through at the time of the next one (1800, 1440, 990 ms, then min_window_ms). repair_cost: what one point costs to put back, between patients; 0 switches repairs off. At 40 a whole pane (three layers) costs one hour of the line.

titles_note: The first entry that fits is used. min_correct counts right calls (out of five). max_injuries is optional. line_held, where an entry has it, must equal the night's last meter reading: a night that ended under the line is THE CUT whatever else went right, and a night that hurt you is not given a title that says it went well.

titles.title: THE CUT
titles.text: Under the line at closing. Harrow Credit sends two quiet people for what is theirs: the chair, the tools, and the hands that used them.

titles.title: STEADY HANDS
titles.text: Five patients, five right calls. The sheet goes back on its nail. You open again tomorrow.

titles.title: RIGHT THE HARD WAY
titles.text: Every call was right, and one of them still reached you. Reading people is half the job. The shutter is the other half.

titles.title: A GOOD NIGHT'S WORK
titles.text: One visit went wrong. Most nights are like that. The rest went the way they should.

titles.title: OPEN, BARELY
titles.text: You were right more often than not. In this trade that is not the same as safe.

titles.title: LICENCE UNDER REVIEW
titles.text: The line held, and that is the kindest thing to say. The sheet was on the wall the whole time. Read it again.

line_text.held: Meter: OVER THE LINE. The lease runs another night.
line_text.short: Meter: UNDER THE LINE. The lease is called in.
